speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, when you say seeing Penny, what exactly does that mean?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: We had dinner last night. She made me spaghetti with little hot dogs cut up in it. Well, little hot dog. I gave up the other five hot dogs to a real dog. A real, big dog. A hell hound. Tangential to the primary story. How about I circle back to it?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Fine. Why did you have dinner with Penny?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I told you, she made spaghetti with little hot dogs. I like spaghetti with little hot dogs.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Then why did you have Chinese food with us?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I didn't want to upset you. Howard made it very clear that my allegiance should be to male comrades before women who sell their bodies for money.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Is it possible he said Bros before Hos?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes, but I rephrased it to avoid offending the hos.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, I don't care if you want to be friends with Penny.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, so the emotional turmoil that's been keeping me from achieving REM sleep was entirely unjustified? Well then as my meemaw would say, looks like we butchered a pig, but nobody wanted bacon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And now, as promised, the tangent. Sheldon and the Hell Hound, or How I Lost My Hot Dogs.
